description: This file defines a ReportService class for generating dataset reports in text or JSON format. It includes helper functions for retrying I/O operations and depends on storage and data services for file management and data processing. The class provides methods to validate input, generate reports with statistics, and manage report file paths.

classes.name: ReportService
classes.description: Service class for generating dataset reports, including text and JSON formats, with support for statistics calculation and report file management.

methods.name: _retry_io(attempts: int = 3, delay: float = 0.1, backoff: float = 2.0)
methods.description: Decorator factory to retry I/O operations with exponential backoff, catching common OSError exceptions.

methods.name: None __init__(self, storage: StorageService, data_service: DataService)
methods.description: Initializes ReportService with storage and data services.

methods.name: str _validate_format(self, fmt: str)
methods.description: Ensures the report format is 'text' or 'json', defaulting to 'text'.

methods.name: Optional[List[str]] _normalize_columns(self, include_columns: Optional[List[str]])
methods.description: Processes include_columns list to remove duplicates and validate entries.

methods.name: str _render_text(self, filename: str, stats: Dict[str, Dict[str, Optional[float]]])
methods.description: Creates a formatted textual report from statistics data.

methods.name: None _write_text(self, path: Path, content: str)
methods.description: Writes report content to a file with retry logic.

methods.name: None _write_json(self, path: Path, payload: dict)
methods.description: Writes a JSON payload to a file with retry logic.

methods.name: Path _build_output_path(self, filename: str, fmt: str)
methods.description: Constructs the output file path based on filename and format.

methods.name: Path generate(self, filename: str, include_columns: Optional[List[str]] = None, fmt: str = "text")
methods.description: Generates a report for a dataset file, returning the path to the saved report.

methods.name: Path get_path(self, report_filename: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the full path to a report file, enforcing directory restrictions.
